length_limits.notes: Main text up to 5,000 words, Methods typically under 3,000, abstract about 150 words and unreferenced, title up to 15 words. Up to 70 references as a guideline.

figure_spec.notes: Up to 10 display items, figures and tables together. Arial or Helvetica; avoid red-green contrast and rainbow scales in favour of colourblind-safe palettes. High resolution is not required at initial submission.

reference_style.style: Numbered, one publication per reference number, each carrying the cited title.

submission_steps: submit through the Manuscript Tracking System at https://mts-ncomms.nature.com/, which requires an account
a cover letter is optional and is used only for information not shared with referees
open the checklist forms in Adobe Reader so their fields are fillable

template.notes: No Nature Communications template exists; the generic Springer Nature package is the only no-login option.
